scope: Selected main-text mean-change estimates and clinical qualifiers; not complete source review of figures or supplementary material
corrections: Observed change is baseline to first follow-up, not from stroke onset; median follow-up 10 weeks after baseline.
Numbers below are subgroup mean changes, not between-group effect sizes or individual prognoses.
Primary figures use RCT-derived participants but age and enrolment timing were not randomised exposures.
Do not infer a causal benefit of earlier therapy: spontaneous recovery could not be accounted for.
No education, handedness or socioeconomic null effect inferred: these were excluded as covariates.
For functional communication, main Results report +0.75 (age<55) and +1.0 (<1 month), while abstract rounds/reports +0.8 and +1.1; use main Results and flag disagreement.
Post-six-month auditory-comprehension estimate CI includes zero despite narrative saying gains evident.
remaining: Named-person approval and reconciliation with existing RELEASE findings; avoid double counting overlapping RELEASE datasets.
Figures 1–3 and supplementary-only estimates not completely adjudicated. Exact final covariate set for each domain cannot be established from main text alone.
